status: Initial engineering rules; human evaluation pending

rules.sentence: we sell your personal data to advertisers
rules.explanation: This statement explicitly permits selling your personal data to advertisers.

rules.sentence: we do not sell your personal data
rules.explanation: This statement explicitly rules out selling your personal data. It does not establish the policy's other sharing practices.

rules.sentence: we share your personal data with advertisers
rules.explanation: This statement permits sharing your personal data with advertisers.

rules.sentence: we retain your personal data indefinitely
rules.explanation: This statement gives no time limit for retaining your personal data.

rules.sentence: we delete your personal data within 30 days after account closure
rules.explanation: This statement sets a 30-day deletion period after account closure.

rules.sentence: we use advertising cookies without your consent
rules.explanation: This statement permits advertising cookies without your consent.

rules.sentence: we use advertising cookies only with your consent
rules.explanation: This statement makes your consent a condition for advertising cookies.
